_avail.description: Companion Add-On Ceiling Mic for Apollo Video Bar
_avail.note: Powered by APO-VX20-UC or COM-MIC-HUB. No direct PDF datasheet on product page (documentation only via WyreStorm partner SharePoint folder, not a direct link).

portsSource.note: Technical Specifications on the manufacturer's product page

_avail.portsMissing: power: the spec sheet says only 'Powered by the APO-VX20-UC or the COM-MIC-HUB', not through which port — marked on RJ45 In (the link from the host); dimensions given without axis order
_avail.notes: Spec: wyrestorm/APO-SKY-MIC_SpecSheet_241003.pdf; weight not published; power: 'Powered by the APO-VX20-UC or the COM-MIC-HUB' (no supply of its own, no figure) (2026-11-27). Power per APO-SKY-MIC_SpecSheet_241003.pdf: 'Powered by the APO-VX20-UC or the COM-MIC-HUB' — powered by host, no supply and no figure of its own (2026-11-27). RJ45 In/Out: the same custom bus as MIC on APO-VX20-UC v2 and Ceiling Mic on COM-MIC-HUB, bidirectional (audio to the host, power from it) so they connect on the schematic; was input/output (2026-11-28).

ports.label: RJ45 In
ports.notes: Apollo mic cascade (custom bus, as the APO-VX20-UC v2 guide calls it: 'Microphone Cascading'); 8-pin RJ45 female; powered by host (APO-VX20-UC or COM-MIC-HUB) over the RJ45 link; from the host or the previous mic

ports.label: RJ45 Out
ports.notes: Apollo mic cascade (custom bus, as the APO-VX20-UC v2 guide calls it: 'Microphone Cascading'); 8-pin RJ45 female; to the next mic
